Hero.Title: Governance and succession
Hero.Description: Clear family governance, a prepared transition. We support family charters, next-generation education and the coordination of succession planning under Swiss law.

Intro: The durability of a family's wealth rests as much on its governance as on its performance. Shared rules, understood and respected, are worth more than decisions taken under pressure.

We help your family set a lasting framework and prepare the transition, in coordination with your lawyers and notaries, and in line with Swiss civil law. Estate planning and any trust or foundation structures are delivered through established Swiss partners; Ridger coordinates them and never acts as trustee.

Pillars.Title: Governance charters
Pillars.Body: Drafting and maintaining family charters that define principles, roles and decision-making.

Pillars.Title: Next generation
Pillars.Body: Supporting and educating the next generation, for a gradual handover of responsibilities.

Pillars.Title: Estate planning
Pillars.Body: In-depth coordination of estate planning with your lawyers and notaries, within the framework of Swiss civil law, through to the implementation of the chosen arrangements.

Pillars.Title: Trusts and foundations
Pillars.Body: Coordination of trust and foundation structures through established Swiss partners. Ridger acts as coordinator and point of contact, never as trustee.

Pillars.Title: Family councils
Pillars.Body: Preparing and facilitating family councils, for structured and documented discussions.

Closing.Title: A composed transition
Closing.Body: A clear framework reduces tension and protects family unity. We coordinate it, discreetly and over the long term.

Perimeter: Execution, custody and asset management remain with your chosen regulated banks and asset managers. Ridger provides consolidation, reporting, coordination and administrative oversight. Ridger does not manage assets and does not provide investment advice.

Questions.Question: What is a family charter for?
Questions.Answer: A family charter sets out the family's principles, roles and decision-making rules. We help draft it, then put it into practice through family councils.

Questions.Question: How is Ridger involved in succession planning?
Questions.Answer: We coordinate succession planning with your lawyers and notaries under Swiss civil law, through to the implementation of the chosen arrangements. Ridger organises and follows the work, while deeds and legal documents remain with your lawyers and notaries.

Questions.Question: Can Ridger act as trustee of our trust or foundation?
Questions.Answer: No. Trust and foundation structures are put in place by established Swiss partners, and Ridger coordinates them as point of contact, never as trustee.

Questions.Question: How do you prepare the next generation?
Questions.Answer: We support the next generation so that responsibilities pass to them gradually. We also prepare and run family councils, with structured and documented discussions.
